verses.en: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
verses.pt: Ora, ouviram os apóstolos e os irmãos que estavam na Judéia que também os gentios haviam recebido a palavra de Deus.
verses.en_web: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
verses.en_bbe: Now the Apostles and the brothers who were in Judaea had news that the word of God had been given to the Gentiles.

verses.en: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
verses.pt: E quando Pedro subiu a Jerusalém, disputavam com ele os que eram da circuncisão,
verses.en_web: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,
verses.en_bbe: And when Peter came to Jerusalem, those who kept the rule of circumcision had an argument with him,

verses.en: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
verses.pt: dizendo: Entraste em casa de homens incircuncisos e comeste com eles.
verses.en_web: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men, and ate with them!”
verses.en_bbe: Saying, You went to men without circumcision, and took food with them.

verses.en: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
verses.pt: Pedro, porém, começou a fazer-lhes uma exposição por ordem, dizendo:
verses.en_web: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,
verses.en_bbe: But Peter gave them an account of it all in order, saying to them,

verses.en: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
verses.pt: Estava eu orando na cidade de Jope, e em êxtase tive uma visão; descia um objeto, como se fosse um grande lençol, sendo baixado do céu pelas quatro pontas, e chegou perto de mim.
verses.en_web: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.
verses.en_bbe: I was in the town of Joppa, at prayer: and falling into a deep sleep, I saw in a vision a vessel like a great cloth let down from heaven, and it came down to me:

verses.en: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
verses.pt: E, fitando nele os olhos, o contemplava, e vi quadrúpedes da terra, feras, répteis e aves do céu.
verses.en_web: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.
verses.en_bbe: And looking on it with attention I saw in it all sorts of beasts and birds.

verses.en: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
verses.pt: Ouvi também uma voz que me dizia: Levanta-te, Pedro, mata e come.
verses.en_web: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’
verses.en_bbe: And a voice came to my ears saying, Come, Peter; take them for food.

verses.en: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
verses.pt: Mas eu respondi: De modo nenhum, Senhor, pois nunca em minha boca entrou coisa alguma comum e imunda.
verses.en_web: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’
verses.en_bbe: But I said, No, Lord; for nothing common or unclean has ever come into my mouth.

verses.en: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
verses.pt: Mas a voz respondeu-me do céu segunda vez: Não chames tu comum ao que Deus purificou.
verses.en_web: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’
verses.en_bbe: But the voice, coming a second time from heaven, said, What God has made clean, do not you make common.

verses.en: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
verses.pt: Sucedeu isto por três vezes; e tudo tornou a recolher-se ao céu.
verses.en_web: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.
verses.en_bbe: And this was done three times, and they were all taken up again into heaven.

verses.en: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.
verses.pt: E eis que, nesse momento, pararam em frente à casa onde estávamos três homens que me foram enviados de Cesaréia.
verses.en_web: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.
verses.en_bbe: And at that minute, three men, sent from Caesarea, came to the house where we were.

verses.en: And the spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house:
verses.pt: Disse-me o Espírito que eu fosse com eles, sem hesitar; e também estes seis irmãos foram comigo e entramos na casa daquele homem.
verses.en_web: The Spirit told me to go with them, without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.
verses.en_bbe: And the Spirit gave me orders to go with them, doubting nothing. And these six brothers came with me; and we went into that man's house:

verses.en: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
verses.pt: E ele nos contou como vira em pé em sua casa o anjo, que lhe dissera: Envia a Jope e manda chamar a Simão, que tem por sobrenome Pedro,
verses.en_web: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house, and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa, and get Simon, who is called Peter,
verses.en_bbe: And he gave us an account of how he had seen the angel in his house, saying, Send to Joppa, and get Simon, named Peter, to come to you;

verses.en: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
verses.pt: o qual te dirá palavras pelas quais serás salvo, tu e toda a tua casa.
verses.en_web: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’
verses.en_bbe: Who will say words to you through which you and all your family may get salvation.

verses.en: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
verses.pt: Logo que eu comecei a falar, desceu sobre eles o Espírito Santo, como também sobre nós no princípio.
verses.en_web: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
verses.en_bbe: And, while I was talking to them, the Holy Spirit came on them, as on us at first.

verses.en: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: Lembrei-me então da palavra do Senhor, como disse: João, na verdade, batizou com água; mas vós sereis batizados no Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’
verses.en_bbe: And the words of the Lord came into my mind, how he said, The baptism of John was with water, but you will have baptism with the Holy Spirit.

verses.en: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
verses.pt: Portanto, se Deus lhes deu o mesmo dom que dera também a nós, ao crermos no Senhor Jesus Cristo, quem era eu, para que pudesse resistir a Deus?
verses.en_web: If then God gave to them the same gift as us, when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”
verses.en_bbe: If then God gave them, when they had faith in the Lord Jesus Christ, the same as he gave to us, who was I to go against God?

verses.en: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
verses.pt: Ouvindo eles estas coisas, apaziguaram-se e glorificaram a Deus, dizendo: Assim, pois, Deus concedeu também aos gentios o arrependimento para a vida.
verses.en_web: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”
verses.en_bbe: And hearing these things they said nothing more, but gave glory to God, saying, Then to the Gentiles as to us has God given a change of heart, so that they may have life.

verses.en: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
verses.pt: Aqueles, pois, que foram dispersos pela tribulação suscitada por causa de Estêvão, passaram até a Fenícia, Chipre e Antioquia, não anunciando a ninguém a palavra, senão somente aos judeus.
verses.en_web: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.
verses.en_bbe: Then those who had gone away at the time of the trouble about Stephen, went as far as Phoenicia and Cyprus, preaching to the Jews only.

verses.en: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.
verses.pt: Havia, porém, entre eles alguns cíprios e cirenenses, os quais, entrando em Antioquia, falaram também aos gregos, anunciando o Senhor Jesus.
verses.en_web: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: But some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, when they came to Antioch, gave the good news about the Lord Jesus to the Greeks.

verses.en: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
verses.pt: E a mão do Senhor era com eles, e grande número creu e se converteu ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: And the power of the Lord was with them, and a great number had faith and were turned to the Lord.

verses.en: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
verses.pt: Chegou a notícia destas coisas aos ouvidos da igreja em Jerusalém; e enviaram Barnabé a Antioquia;
verses.en_web: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,
verses.en_bbe: And news of them came to the ears of the church at Jerusalem: and they sent Barnabas as far as Antioch:

verses.en: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
verses.pt: o qual, quando chegou e viu a graça de Deus, se alegrou, e exortava a todos a perseverarem no Senhor com firmeza de coração;
verses.en_web: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Who, when he came and saw the grace of God, was glad; and he made clear to them the need of keeping near the Lord with all the strength of their hearts:

verses.en: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
verses.pt: porque era homem de bem, e cheio do Espírito Santo e de fé. E muita gente se uniu ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: For he was a good man and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith: and a great number were joined to the Lord.

verses.en: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
verses.pt: Partiu, pois, Barnabé para Tarso, em busca de Saulo;
verses.en_web: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.
verses.en_bbe: Then he went on to Tarsus, looking for Saul;

verses.en: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
verses.pt: e tendo-o achado, o levou para Antioquia. E durante um ano inteiro reuniram-se naquela igreja e instruíram muita gente; e em Antioquia os discípulos pela primeira vez foram chamados cristãos.
verses.en_web: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had come across him, he took him to Antioch. And they were with the church there for a year, teaching the people; and the disciples were first given the name of Christians in Antioch.

verses.en: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
verses.pt: Naqueles dias desceram profetas de Jerusalém para Antioquia;
verses.en_web: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
verses.en_bbe: Now in those days prophets came from Jerusalem to Antioch.

verses.en: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.
verses.pt: e levantando-se um deles, de nome Ágabo, dava a entender pelo Espírito, que haveria uma grande fome por todo o mundo, a qual ocorreu no tempo de Cláudio.
verses.en_web: One of them named Agabus stood up, and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.
verses.en_bbe: And one of them, named Agabus, said publicly through the Spirit that there would be serious need of food all over the earth: which came about in the time of Claudius.

verses.en: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:
verses.pt: E os discípulos resolveram mandar, cada um conforme suas posses, socorro aos irmãos que habitavam na Judéia;
verses.en_web: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;
verses.en_bbe: And the disciples, everyone as he was able, made a decision to send help to the brothers living in Judaea:

verses.en: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
verses.pt: o que eles com efeito fizeram, enviando-o aos anciãos por mão de Barnabé e Saulo.
verses.en_web: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
verses.en_bbe: Which they did, sending it to the rulers of the church by the hand of Barnabas and Saul.
